text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you've been working hard for 
the Umamusume today as well, my little 
lamb!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Your own growth will directly lead to <chrname>'s 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Show me you can sprint down the path 
illuminated by the sun that you're meant 
to follow!
